question: Do loss weighting and PCGrad change local useful-lead event-loss update directions when actual AdamW moments and weight decay are retained?
data: One fixed 256-row training batch per shard, all 48 training shards and original three seeds; no calibration statistics or test access.
reporting: Report all four cells, all events and seeds; raw-gradient versus actual AdamW first-order and same-dropout observed loss changes. Restore the same source checkpoint and optimizer before every virtual step. No new fitted model or checkpoint is saved.
interpretation: Descriptive local probes, not a gradient-conflict diagnosis or prediction of alternative full-training outcomes. Equal weights preserve total loss weight 5.5. All virtual steps start with moments learned under original weights.
